notes.title: NEW DEMO IS LIVE!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44627086/5d9f861e50e9bea36ee34321ccd74a2beec11154.gif[/img]
[h1]THE NEW DEMO HAS LANDED[/h1]

Diner Managers of the Galaxy,

We're very excited to announce that a new demo is out! After more than a year of further development, we've got an advanced beta that's ready to be tried out — most of the major features are now available for you to experience.

Here are the demo's limitations:
[list]
[*] The demo lasts 2 in-game years, after which the game will automatically end.
[*] Special rooms are locked — they'll play an important role in generating money and visitor satisfaction in the later stages of the main game.
[*] The Expeditions feature is locked — we're still fine-tuning it!
[/list]
Also, please note that you may encounter some weird bugs or imperfections in the art and audio assets. We're working on those.

We would really appreciate it if you reported any bugs you find. Head over to the discussion board — you'll see a pinned post where we explain how to locate your game logs and saves, which are reeeaaally helpful in fixing the issues you encounter.

And lastly — if you like this little preview, please share and pass it on. Add us to your wishlist and spread the word on your socials!

We hope you enjoy it, and we're looking forward to hearing your feedback.

[h3]THE GENERAL INTERACTIVE TEAM[/h3]

notes.title: Development Update: A Before-and-After Progress Report
notes.content:
[h3]Greetings, Intergalactic Diner Managers!
[/h3]
A belated happy new year to everyone. What better time than now to take a moment to reflect and look back on all the progress we've made in the last 12 months - and we've made plenty!

From a complete UI overhaul to tons of QoL improvements, new objects and animations to bug fixes, we're getting closer and closer to a release-ready build.

But why read all this when you can see it for yourself -- watch the video below and see us put a build from exactly one year ago side-by-side with our latest build for comparison.

[previewyoutube=tyg2xup20t4;full][/previewyoutube]
On top of that, we're also hoping to get a demo ready in the next month - and once we do, we'll make sure to release an update.

So do stay tuned, and if you haven't already, add us to your wishlist and give us a follow on Steam.

Speak to you all again very soon!

[b]The General Interactive Team[/b]

notes.title: New Look, New Trailer, New Publisher and Lots of New Progress
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, diner managers!
[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44627086/cdde1ba24a09c4446c7e7ac7ccafd5c5ccdd1c48.png[/img]

We've got so much new updates to share! The last time we updated the steam store page, it was 2023 and we were deep into the alpha phase of development. We had just the bare bones of the game to show - and it was just us, a development team of four, doing all the heavy lifting.

How things have changed.

We are proud to announce that we've recently just hit our beta milestone!
 During these past handful of months, we've worked our way to becoming officially feature complete (and picked up shortlists at SXSW Sydney and the Southeast Asia Game Awards along the way). That means the next few months will be dedicated to implementing new content - quests, items and objects, UI improvements, animations and music - and bug crunching.

And our brand new trailer shows off a lot of our progress. To coincide with our participation in Steam's Cooking Fest, we've totally revamped our store page to show off our new trailer, new screenshots and even new key art! [b]We're even playing a dev stream where Mark, Neil and Ricardo do a quick playthrough just for the event, so do check that out on the main store page.[/b]

[h3][url=https://www.gamespress.com/en-US/Astra-Logical-signs-The-Diner-at-the-End-of-the-Galaxy]Lastly, we are very excited to share that the game was signed by publisher, Astra Logical, who will be publishing the game on PC and XBOX.[/url][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44627086/469e8b17a804910b56a30e8a91c840713ac67d97.png[/img]

They've been a game changer for us, and are investing in playtests and QA in order to ensure that when we release some time in the first half of 2025, you're getting a solid day one build of the game.

So make sure you stay tuned because we're hoping to post occasional dev diaries to show off our progress. Follow us on our Steam page community, and track us on our other social channels.

We're looking forward to showing you more as development continues!


[h3]Stay safe and keep that Bushbean soup cooking!
[/h3]
[b]The 'Diner at the End of the Galaxy' Development Team[/b]

notes.title: THE DEVS BUILD A DINER
notes.content:
[h1]Watch us build and run a diner![/h1]

We took you through the core gameplay in our last video - now, we're diving deeper into the mechanics. In fact, we actually want to try to build a decent looking diner - not the pitiful excuse for an intergalactic cantina we managed in our last stream. Easier said than done, but LFG.

Quick note - this will be a pre-recorded video (it will be recorded just a few hours before it is broadcast). That's because livestreaming isn't our forte, and the myriad of technical difficulties that come with a 4-person stream across various time zones is honestly quite stressful. It'll be great all the same!

[b]See you there![/b]

[b]Neil / Ricardo / Mikey / Mark[/b]
